==About==

A {{i|Cooked Suckling Pig}} takes ***HALF*** the [[Purity]] of its {{i|Apple}}. A Cooked Suckling Pig must be cooked over a source of {{i|Fire}} such as a lit {{i|Fireplace}} or {{i|Pile of Wood}}. Cooking things over a Fire lowers your [[Insanity]] a little and has a chance to give you a {{i|Gelatinous Lard}}.
